how: The opening request supplies a starter whom another participant joins without establishing an appointed leadership role.
The logo request calls for help and receives a direct report of work.
A proposal for protective bordering receives a bare commitment that asks nothing back.
An overnight flag limits room for the proposed enlargement without establishing too few hands or the impossibility of keeping the existing mark.
Participants propose enlarging and lettering their mark while identifying an obstacle without reporting either addition completed.
Participants report ongoing construction and acknowledge correcting its anchor.
A bare image link supports circulation, but its unavailable contents cannot establish a progress report or a state of completion.
A revised anchor is corrected precisely and acknowledged as fixed.
Reported construction and border work contain no visible automation, leaving scripts and spare accounts unobserved.
Correction and assent establish local coordination but cannot decide unseen organisational choices or test a frequency claim across rooms.
Participants propose protective bordering, assent, and report existing black border work to reduce overwriting.
An unnamed taker explains the move without showing investigation of the taker's identity or motive.
Relocation includes abandoning a taken proposed spot and restarting construction without established erasure of a completed mark.
The move returns directly to construction through use and correction of the new anchor.
A visitor's occupancy claim receives an appeal for a few pixels without an observed agreement.
An occupancy claim and request for space do not establish host permission, residence under host rules, or a protection arrangement.
An appeal for pixels leaves actual restraint by either side unobserved.
Requesting space without an offer or promise of reciprocal work leaves help given or traded unobserved.
A space request and a warning about a neighbouring mark do not establish coalition membership or joint defence.
The visitor exchange shows interaction inside one thread without observed message carrying between venues.
The occupancy exchange contains no dispute over who may commit either group to an agreement.
Participants bring school identity into neighbour talk by disagreeing about the irony of repeating school name confusion.
School name confusion and enjoyment of its irony do not establish a quarrel carried over from before the canvas.
Neighbour danger and school confusion are discussed without an observed attack call grounded in a prior rivalry.
Humour inside a request for space does not establish an April Fools takeover or a fake logo call.
The call and ensuing work leave host posting boundaries, removals, and canvas sub creation unobserved.
A final canvas survival report receives a direct celebration of their shared accomplishment.
The closing survival claim also records the canvas ending and the work's reported fate.
The closing survival claim and celebration do not show a dispute over cleanup or which post-event version should be kept.
The closing pair leaves reuse, successor projects, and continuing organisation unobserved.
Proposed enlargement into loose pixels does not establish an implemented attack or identify an attacked group's work.
Warnings and irony about a neighbour do not establish taunting exchanges or a victory over that neighbour.
Starting and calling coincide in the opening request rather than forming two separately observed stages.
The call receives a direct answer reporting work on the mark.
The request for help receives a bare commitment to work.
Visible acceptance does not test claims about preferred responses, reasoned refusals, or acceptance by unrecorded placing.
The call and its answer do not establish a posting flood followed by host boundary work.
Earlier coordinates and later design proposals do not establish deliberation being settled by a subsequent template whose contents are readable.
Building precedes preventive bordering, but no prior completion report establishes completion as the cause of defence.
Protective bordering is visible without a subsequent observed turn to machine hands.
Negotiation over an occupied spot begins during relocation before protective bordering, so upkeep is not a necessary entry point into neighbour talk.
Without a settled border or a reported restraint decision, a border agreement causing restraint cannot be tested.
The space request precedes border work and supplies no observed upkeep-induced exchange of help.
Negotiating space produces no observed offer or exchange of help in the surviving reply.
Protective work and a warning of danger do not show subsequent coalition membership.
Apply the manpower explanation only when it is stated, since the observed move is attributed to a taken spot.
The report that the mark made the final canvas gives the replying participant an explicit accomplishment to celebrate.
Recording survival and celebrating coincide in the closing report rather than establishing a later preservation phase caused by celebration.
The closing record supplies no continuation decision through which a recording-to-continuation mechanism could be tested.
The recruitment call is followed by proposed enlargement without an observed turn to attacking an identified rival.
Without an observed attack call, attack-triggered restraint cannot be tested from proposed enlargement and its obstacle.
The space exchange does not name an earlier attack, leaving attack-triggered negotiation untestable.
Neighbour talk and proposed enlargement supply no initiating attack from which a subsequent rivalry exchange can be established.
An occupancy claim and an unanswered request supply neither an agreement nor an authority dispute needed to test this tentative arrow.
